original.target_description: Exercise-duration difference scores: individual control versus each conjunctive virtual-partner condition, with exclusive encouragement or no encouragement; post hoc Dunette comparisons.

p.quote: Post hoc Dunette tests indicated that the difference between Individuals and Partners was significant ( P <.001) in both partner conditions.

notes: The paper prints P<.001 for each individual-versus-partner comparison but does not print a single pooled comparison or an effect size for these post hoc tests. No omnibus effect size was paired with their p value. Replication title and DOI verified against publisher metadata, but accessible material was abstract-only. Publisher full-text route returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; targeted repository/preprint searches and author Academia profile supplied no accessible full text. No replication values or narrative verdict were extracted from the abstract.
